_documentation.model_purpose: Class-Weighted Gradient Boosting & Dynamic ATR Triple Barrier Regime Classifier
_documentation.return_formula: Dynamic ATR Triple Barrier Outcome y_tb in {+1 [Profit +2.0x ATR_14], -1 [Loss -1.0x ATR_14], 0 [Time-Stop 10d]}
_documentation.horizon_gate: Vertical barrier horizon = 10 daily bars. Triple Barrier labeling.

state_hierarchy.L3: Wave Direction State: W_slope (6 macro wave slope states)
state_hierarchy.L2: Mid-Micro State: W_slope|σVc (30 mid-wave cycle states)
state_hierarchy.L1: Full 4D State: W_slope|σVc|σc|vel_σVw (450 granular micro timing states)

field_glossary.n_samples: Sample size for this kinematic cluster
field_glossary.p_triple_barrier_tp: Probability of hitting Take Profit (+4%) first within 10 days
field_glossary.p_triple_barrier_sl: Probability of hitting Stop Loss (-2%) first within 10 days
field_glossary.p_triple_barrier_timeout: Probability of expiring at 10-day vertical barrier
field_glossary.ev_net: Real Triple Barrier Expected Value: P(TP)*E[max] + P(SL)*E[min]

_documentation.signal_interpretation_policy: Clean Architecture Standard: Business signals are dynamically evaluated in runtime by pure-domain adapters using machine learning P(TP), EV, and R:R asymmetry.
